name: Chocobo Rescue

start.dialog: My chocobo... got spooked and ran into the Mire. Little guy's probably scared and stuck in the mud. Help me find him? He's more than just a bird to me.
start.objective: Search the Mire for Sazh's lost chocobo

progress.dialog: Chocobo! Where are you, buddy? I got gysahl greens! Your favorite!

complete.dialog: There you are! *hugs bird* Thanks, friend. I owe you big. Here - take these. Chocobo feathers. They bring good luck. And this gun - I got a spare.

party_comments.kade: He really loves that bird. I get it.
party_comments.twist: The chocobo is so FLUFFY! Can I ride it?!

hidden_outcome: If you find the chocobo within 2 minutes (speed challenge), Sazh gives you 'Procyon' - his ultimate guns
